name: Twilio
scope_notes: Twilio cloud APIs; PKCV needs Enterprise or Security Edition, OAuth apps are US1-only, and Monitor Events keeps 30 days (13 months with Administration, Security or Enterprise Edition).

controls.name: Auth Token rotation (secondary + promote)
controls.what: Promoting the secondary token deletes the old primary.
controls.setting: Console > API keys & tokens > Auth Tokens; POST https://accounts.twilio.com/v1/AuthTokens/Secondary, POST https://accounts.twilio.com/v1/AuthTokens/Promote

controls.name: Enforce Public Key Client Validation
controls.what: Makes the Auth Token invalid for REST requests; requests must be signed with a registered key.
controls.setting: Console > Settings > Enforce Public Key Client Validation

controls.name: Restricted API key permissions
controls.what: Key can call only selected endpoints/actions.
controls.setting: Console > API keys & auth tokens > Create API key > Restricted; POST https://iam.twilio.com/v1/Keys

controls.name: Delete API key
controls.what: Revokes REST access and invalidates Access Tokens signed with the key.
controls.setting: Console > API keys > Delete this key; DELETE https://iam.twilio.com/v1/Keys/{Sid}

controls.name: Token expiration time
controls.what: Sets access token lifetime from 1 minute to 30 days.
controls.setting: OAuth app > Access settings > Token expiration time

controls.name: Rotate secret (grace period 0) / delete OAuth app
controls.what: Invalidates old credentials and issued access tokens.
controls.setting: OAuth app > Credentials > Rotate secret; OAuth apps > Delete

controls.name: Suspend or close subaccount
controls.what: Stops a subaccount; closed subaccounts are deleted after 30 days by default.

no_control.what: PKCV cannot be enforced on accounts that use Flex, Studio or TaskRouter, so the Auth Token stays valid there.

controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for REST API credentials (Auth Token, API keys, OAuth).
Expiry settings for API keys and Auth Tokens.

authentication.summary: Account SID as username and Auth Token as password (HTTP Basic). One primary token per account gives admin-level API access; parent tokens also reach subaccount v2010 resources.

federation.details: SSO enforcement applies to user login; docs do not say it affects Auth Token use.

ip_restriction.boundary: No documented IP allowlist for REST API credentials.

renewal.summary: Create secondary token, update apps, promote it (old primary deleted).

administration.summary: Rotation via Console or AuthTokens API; every change emails owners and admins. PKCV enforcement makes the Auth Token invalid for REST.

offboard.details: The Auth Token belongs to the account. Deleting a user does not delete the accounts they own or can access.

token_format.notes: Account SID starts with AC; Auth Token has no documented prefix.

credentials.name: Organization OAuth app (Client Credentials / Authorization Code)

authentication.summary: Only way to call organization-level APIs. Client credentials for machines; authorization code with refresh token on behalf of a user.

federation.details: Authorization code flow uses the user's Twilio sign-in; effect of SSO on refresh tokens not documented.

renewal.summary: Authorization code apps use a refresh token; client credentials apps re-request.

credentials.name: Public Key Client Validation (signed request JWT)

authentication.summary: Each request carries a JWT signed with the customer's RSA private key (kid = public key CredentialSid, iss = API key SID) plus API key credentials. When enforced, Auth Token alone is rejected for REST.

renewal.summary: New JWT per request; rotate key pairs via Credentials PublicKeys.

administration.summary: Enforced from Console Settings; cannot be enforced if Flex, Studio or TaskRouter are used.

offboard.details: Signed requests use an account's API key and public key credential, which belong to the account, not a user.

inventory.details: GET https://accounts.twilio.com/v1/Credentials/PublicKeys lists public key credentials, one account at a time.

expiry.api: Set the exp claim in the signed request JWT; max exp - nbf is 300 s

usage.ui: Monitor > Insights > Audit > Audit Events Log

containment.steps: Delete the public key credential and the API key used as iss.
containment.notes: Deleting the API key used as iss revokes REST API authentication. Docs do not separately describe deleting the public key credential.
